title: Hurom H320 Cold Press Juicer Machine, Easy to Clean Masticating Slow Juicer, Coarse Strainers, Self-Feeding, Hands Free, Family Size, Quiet Motor, Easy Assembly (Black)
features: ULTRA LOW PULP: Features a control lever and fine and coarse strainers, enabling you to adjust the pulp level to suit your taste. The auger squeezes produce like a hand-squeezer, leaving bone-dry pulp and all the goodness in your glass.

FAMILY SIZE: Designed with a high volume self-feeding hopper that fits whole produce, and a larger opening and inlet to add more ingredients even while the juice maker is still running. It’s the perfect choice for families and committed juicers.

EVERY DROP COUNTS: Our patented Slow Squeeze technology minimizes oxidation for fresher, nutrient-rich juice. The masticating juicer extracts every last drop of juice possible from fruits and vegetables for a higher yield and fresher taste that lasts up to 72 hours.

QUIET MOTOR: The near-silent AC motor is whisper quiet, and won’t wake the household before breakfast - perfect for early mornings and quiet evenings. It’s easy assembly also makes the juice extractor ideal for juicing beginners and veterans alike.
